what: Renderer grep `\$\{[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*//[^/]*/\$` matches any replacement starting with `$`, but edge cases claim `$'...'` ANSI-C forms are excluded with no matching filter
scenario_or_breakage: The lone in-repo safe site `${out//$'\n'/$'\n' }` is flagged on first `make lint`; authors must add waivers or the linter fails green-tree
suggested_fix: After the grep match, skip when the replacement token after the second `/` is `$'` (ANSI-C); document that rule in `lint-renderer-substitution-safety.md` and add a harness pass case mirroring `test-check-review-changes.sh:119`
